name: Corgi FTSE U.S. TIPS Bond ETF
name_en: Corgi FTSE U.S. TIPS Bond ETF
desc: Under normal circumstances, at least 80% of the value of its net assets, plus borrowings for investment purposes, in inflation-protected U.S. Treasury bonds ("TIPS") that comprise the index. The index comprises U.S. government inflation-linked securities eligible for the FTSE World Inflation-Linked Securities 0+ Years Index. It is non-diversified.
